name: claude-skills
description: Personal Claude Code skills, versioned in git so they stay in sync across machines and accounts.

plugins.name: ebook-lecture-notes
plugins.description: Turn ebooks into layered study notes written in the voice of a senior lecturer — named mental models, data-backed charts, a critical layer that argues against the book, and a self-test. Handles single books or a whole directory in batch.

plugins.name: find-skills
plugins.description: Discovers and installs agent skills from the open skills.sh ecosystem — checks the leaderboard, searches the skills CLI, vets quality (install count, source reputation, GitHub stars) before recommending, and installs the right skill for a task.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Plan with the expensive model, execute with cheap parallel subagents. Produces a concrete plan using the session's active model (Opus/Fable), then fans the well-specified grunt work out to parallel Sonnet subagents to save tokens.

plugins.name: rnd
plugins.description: General-purpose R&D investigation pipeline for any domain — software systems, tools, frameworks, techniques, product features, infrastructure, or workflows. Researches a topic and produces a structured report.

plugins.name: skill-scout
plugins.description: Before a substantial task, finds existing agent skills that fit it, vets and security-reviews them, installs only the ones you approve, then continues the task.

plugins.name: system-builder
plugins.description: Phase-gated workflow for building a new system end to end: kickoff interview, multi-agent R&D, detailed planning, subagent code execution, then review and demo. Pairs with the orchestrate plugin when installed.

plugins.name: trading-system-review
plugins.description: Fresh-eyes senior-trader review of an existing trading system: fresh backtest, deflated Sharpe / PBO / Monte Carlo / regime stats, today's-market web research, a 10-dimension gated rubric, and an offline HTML report with a deploy / incubate / revamp / retire verdict.

plugins.name: trading-rnd
plugins.description: Deep R&D investigation pipeline for US-stocks auto-trading topics — strategies, indicators, market data, broker capabilities, risk management, and backtesting — producing a structured report with a feasibility assessment.

plugins.name: video-analysis
plugins.description: Watch, analyze, and take structured knowledge notes from videos. Handles YouTube, TikTok, Douyin, RedNote/Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, any yt-dlp-supported site, or a local file, by decomposing the video into frames plus a transcript and writing timestamped notes.

plugins.name: web-pentest
plugins.description: Phase-gated authorized web pentest workflow for bug-bounty/VDP targets: Phase 0 scope+RoE gate (hard-stops if out of scope), recon, surface mapping, 8-class checklist testing via Burp Suite MCP, PoC confirmation, and chaining into a structured findings folder. Methodology orchestration, not exploit payloads. Bundles a companion report-submission skill that turns findings into platform-ready report submissions (HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti, YesWeHack).
